common_other_side.drawing_description: Bent figure with oblique side ticks, U with outward top ticks, E-like comb; primary numbered glyphs48,342,176.

paired_context_check.identity_authentication: M087 andM089 labelled primary Sign List printed32/PDF43; M328 printed34/PDF45; M048 printed32, M342 printed35, M176 printed33.
paired_context_check.structural_inference: Exact same normalized other-side sequence can accompany different stroke-group+M328 sequences. This is a counterexample to a deterministic mapping from that exact other-side text alone to the stroke group.
not_demonstrated: Semantic translation of M328 or other signs
